title: Proactive Traffic Optimization in 6G IoT Networks via Hybrid Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning
content: The sixth-generation (6G) networks are required to support scalable and low-latency traffic management due to emerging Internet of Things (IoT) applications. This paper proposes a traffic control framework in 6G IoT networks that integrates hybrid deep learning–based traffic prediction with prediction-driven deep reinforcement learning (DRL). A hybrid spatio-temporal deep learning model combining convolutional, recurrent, attention, and ensemble components captures complex IoT traffic dynamics. Unlike existing loosely coupled prediction–RL approaches, the predicted traffic demand is explicitly embedded into the RL state representation, enabling proactive and coordinated optimization of clustering, routing, and wireless resource allocation. NS-3 simulations with up to 1000 IoT nodes show that the proposed predictor achieves a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.0079, outperforming LSTM, GRU, and CNN–GRU baselines. Furthermore, the prediction-driven DRL framework reduces end-to-end delays by 31% and improves throughput by 28% compared to DRL-only optimization, while also enhancing packet delivery ratio and energy efficiency. These results demonstrate that tightly integrating traffic prediction with reinforcement learning enhances proactive traffic control in large-scale 6G IoT networks.
